statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: This afternoon and tonight. A strong cold front is moving through the area today that has produced a line of embedded thunderstorms along the front. Wind damage has been reported with these storms. They should be out of the area within the next 2 hours. In addition, outside of any showers or storms, wind could gust near 40-45 mph at times across eastern Tucker county West Virginia this afternoon into this evening.
